entries.text: The Spark adapter receives query results with DataFrame.toArrow when the installed PySpark provides it (4.0 and newer), with Arrow-enabled toPandas on older versions, and with collect() otherwise; the fetch_mode result field records which path was used. Spark defaults to Arrow only where toArrow exists; LakeSail, Velox and Snowpark Connect stay on rows, and the cloud Spark adapters are unchanged.
details: Digests and row values match collect() for scalar, decimal, date, timestamp, binary, array, map and struct columns, verified on PySpark 4.2.0 with JDK 17.
Set the fetch_mode platform option to rows to use collect().
